game_facts.aliases: Everyone plays under a secret alias assigned by the bot at /join; all game output uses aliases.

style._about: Look and sound for every stage. Changing anything here marks all assets and scenes for redo.

fonts.headline: Fredoka Bold, or the nearest bold rounded sans available
fonts.body: Inter SemiBold, or the nearest clean sans available
fonts.ui_mockups: Inter or the system sans, so screens look like a real chat app

text_rules.on_screen_text_position: upper third, centred, inside the safe margin
text_rules.captions: bottom centre, 44 px, light text on a 70% black rounded box, max 2 lines of 42 characters

motion_rules: Ease in-out on everything; pops and stamps take 0.25-0.35 s.
Hold every on-screen text line for at least 2 seconds.
No strobing: any flicker stays below 3 flashes per second.
Each scene starts when its voiceover paragraph starts.
Action icons always appear in their action colour, inside a circular badge.
style.art_direction: Flat, friendly cartoon. Simple round avatars with dot eyes only. Night scenes are dark navy, not scary.
brand_rules: Chat screens look like a modern chat app (dark sidebar, channel list, messages) but never use the Discord logo, wordmark or mascot.
The narration may say 'Discord'; the visuals stay generic.
Only the example names from game.json appear on screen.

audio.voice: Calm and slightly dramatic, like a late-night radio host. 48 kHz mono WAV, one file per scene.
audio.music: Low, tense, royalty-free background beat, about 15-20 dB under the voice. Cuts out at the drumroll in scene 13, back for scene 14.
audio.final_loudness: about -16 LUFS integrated, peaks below -1 dBTP

export.scene_clips: 1920x1080, 30 fps, no audio, exactly the scene's duration_s
export.final: H.264 MP4, 1920x1080, 30 fps, high quality (CRF about 18); AAC 48 kHz 192 kbps stereo; captions burned in

scenes.title: Hook
scenes.narration: For the next two weeks, the office becomes a survival game. Food is scarce, everyone is hungry, and anyone could turn on you.

beats.do: Office floor plan fades in at night (office_floorplan_night).
Two or three desk lamps flicker gently (under 3 flashes per second).
Desks morph into tents one cluster at a time (tent, top_down).
title_logo slams in centre with a small dust puff; hold to the end.

scenes.title: The goal
scenes.narration: The game runs for ten workdays. Your goal: stay alive, and on the last night, grab one of five seats on the rescue helicopter.

beats.do: calendar_strip slides in from the left.
Tiles tick off one by one, evenly, until all 10 are ticked by 6.0 s.
Camera pans right to the helicopter with 5 empty seats, rotor idling.
On-screen text appears.

scenes.title: Food
scenes.narration: Everyone starts with seven rations. Every night, you eat one. Run out, and you become a bandit. More on that later.

beats.do: One avatar (standing) with 7 ration_tin in a row beside them.
moon_sun cycles above; each night 1 tin pops away, speeding up, until none are left at 7.0 s.
bandit_mask drops onto the avatar's face with a thunk; hold.

scenes.title: Your daily move
scenes.narration: Each day, you pick one secret move in Discord before midnight. Nobody else can see what you chose. You have five options.
scenes.on_screen_text: 1 secret move a day, before midnight

beats.do: ui_phone_chat slides up from the bottom.
Thumb taps the message box; '/steal' types in.
Phone shrinks to the left; the five action_icons fan out in an arc with their labels.
On-screen text appears.

scenes.title: Scavenge
scenes.narration: Scavenge. Go looking for food and find nothing, one or two rations. If you forget to play, you scavenge automatically.

beats.do: icon_scavenge badge pins to the top-left corner and stays for the scene.
Avatar (digging pose) rummages in the bin.
slot_counter spins and lands on each value from 0 to 2 in turn, a tin popping out for each.
Small clock icon with 'missed it? auto-scavenge'.

scenes.title: Steal
scenes.narration: Steal. Pick someone and take two of their rations. They'll know they were robbed. They won't know it was you.

beats.do: icon_steal badge pins top-left. Avatar sleeping beside 4 tins.
thief_shadow tiptoes in from the right.
Thief lifts 2 tins and slips away.
Avatar wakes (startled pose) with question_mark bouncing above.

scenes.title: Guard
scenes.narration: Guard. You're protected tonight and tomorrow night. Anyone who tries to rob you gets caught, named in the news, and pays you two rations. You only get three guards, so choose your moment.
scenes.on_screen_text: GUARD: 2 nights · thief pays you 2 · 3 per game

beats.do: icon_guard badge pins top-left. Avatar with shield_glow over them.
2 nights pass above (moon, sun, moon) to show the shield lasting.
thief_shadow sneaks in and bounces off the shield.
spotlight snaps on the thief; small banner 'CAUGHT'.
Thief hands 2 tins to the guard.
shield_counter appears: 3 shields, one greys out.

scenes.title: Investigate
scenes.narration: Investigate. Spy on one person and find out what they did that night. Catch them stealing, and they're exposed and pay you one ration.

beats.do: icon_investigate badge pins top-left. Row of tents (front_with_window), night.
magnifying_glass_large sweeps across the tents and stops at one window.
Through the lens: thief_shadow taking a tin.
stamp_exposed slams over the window.
1 tin flies from the thief to the investigator avatar.

scenes.title: Gift
scenes.narration: Gift. Give some of your food to someone else. Only the two of you will know.

beats.do: icon_gift badge pins top-left. Two avatars side by side, soft purple glow.
One avatar passes a tin to the other.
Both do the finger-to-lips pose.

scenes.title: The morning news
scenes.narration: Every morning at half past seven, the news drops in Discord: who got robbed, who got caught, and who ran out of food. You'll always know what happened. You'll rarely know who did it.

beats.do: ui_news_post slides in; header '07:30 MORNING NEWS'.
Line 1 appears (robbery).
Line 2 appears (caught thief).
Line 3 appears (ran out of food).
A big '?' fades in over the screen on 'You'll rarely know who did it'.

scenes.title: Bandits
scenes.narration: Run out of food and you're a bandit. Bandits can only steal, but get back to three rations and you rejoin the survivors.

beats.do: Avatar wearing bandit_mask sneaks between tents.
Steals 1 tin at a time; a counter above them climbs from 0 to 3.
bandit_mask flies off; the avatar's colours brighten back to normal.

scenes.title: Secret goal and radio
scenes.narration: You'll also get a secret goal that only you know about. And once a day you can post an anonymous message on the radio channel. Tips, accusations, lies. Your call.
scenes.on_screen_text: Secret goal · 1 anonymous radio message a day

beats.do: secret_envelope drops in and wobbles; wax seal glints. Never open it.
Cut to ui_radio_channel with radio_icon; three anonymous messages pop in at 5.5, 7.0 and 8.5 s.
On-screen text appears.

scenes.title: Extraction and the reveal
scenes.narration: On the last night, the helicopter lands. The five survivors with the most food get a seat. A seat and your secret goal both earn points, and the most points wins. Then comes the big reveal: every theft and every secret, out in the open.

beats.do: Night sky; helicopter descends, rotor spinning, dust blowing.
5 avatars (mixed colours) climb aboard one by one; seats light up.
scoreboard flips in.
MUSIC CUT. Drumroll.
curtain pulls open on news_clipping_wall with 'THE REVEAL' in the headline font.

scenes.title: How to join
scenes.narration: It takes two minutes a day, it's completely optional, and nothing in the game touches real work or real money. Type slash join in Discord and you'll get a secret alias, so nobody knows who's who. And remember: trust no one.

beats.do: ui_join: '/join' typed, the bot's private reply reveals the alias 'RustyKettle'.
Background: tents morph back into desks; lights come up to day_bg.
End card: title_logo (small) + 'trust no one'. Hold to the end.
